rationale: The blind translation is a complete closed realization of the selected p=2 corrected-midpoint coefficient certificate. Up to harmless renaming, its matrices and vectors are exactly A, A^epsilon, tilde-A, b, b^epsilon, tilde-b, c, c^epsilon, tilde-c, and e from the paper. Its thirteen equalities contain the displayed coefficient relations, both order-two consistency conditions, all smooth perturbation conditions through m=2, and both nonsmooth componentwise conditions. The identities beyond those printed immediately below the page-11 arrays are exact substitutions into conditions (3.4a)-(3.5c), not unrelated additions. The translation neither replaces the certificate with the subsequent stability-conditional global big-O expectation nor introduces a different norm, precision model, dimension, or error notion.
